Who here agrees?|Isa Durand and a Devaronian captain, shortly before the latter's punishment|audio=IsaDurandCaptain-PathsUnknown.flac|}} [[Lady]] '''Isa Durand''' was a famed [[Devaronian]] [[Gender|female]] [[Crime lord|crime boss]] who led the [[Durand crime family]]'s syndicate and its [[Durand's Council]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[19 BBY]], her son [[Roland Durand]]'s horn was severed by a [[Unidentified Pyke (Ord Mantell)|Pyke operative]], disgracing the Durands. Eventually, Roland convinced her to allow the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch's]] [[Cloning|clone]] [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] to bring the [[Pyke]] to them. During or after [[18 BBY]], she presided over the trial of a [[Unidentified Devaronian captain|Devaronian captain]] accused of conspiracy against the Durand family, ultimately declaring him guilty and sending him falling into a dark pit. Afterward, when Bad Batch members [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] delivered the Pyke who had harmed Roland to Isa, she allowed her son to give the clones the information they sought—coordinates to the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]]'s [[Tantiss Base|laboratory]]—before indicating they should leave. ==Biography== {{Dialogue|Isa Durand|Such courage to demand an audience with me. You'd be dead if my son hadn't convinced me to consider your offer.|Hunter|And we're here to deliver. You asked for the Pyke who disgraced your family.|Wrecker|He's all yours.|Hunter|It won't be traced back to you. We made sure of it.|attr=Isa Durand, Hunter, and Wrecker|audio=IsaDurandHunterWrecker-PathsUnknown.flac|src=}} [[File:Durands-TBBPathsUnknown.png|thumb|left|300px|Isa and Roland Durand in their fortress on Devaron]] [[Lady]] Isa Durand was a [[Devaronian]] [[Gender|female]] who was active by the [[time]] of the [[Imperial Era]]. As a prominent''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' and famed [[Crime lord|crime boss]] of the [[Durand crime family|Durand family]], she was part of the [[Durand's Council]], which issued punishments to those who committed crimes against the family's syndicate. Durand was the [[Parent|mother]] of [[Roland Durand]], a Devaronian male criminal. In [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Infested]]" to [[19 BBY]]. while under the [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s custody, Roland told the [[human]] female [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] about{{TBB|Infested}} his family's way of taking what they wanted, a tactic he claimed Isa had perfected. After escaping, he chose to begin operating more closely with his mother{{Databank|roland-durand|Roland Durand}} in his [[Durand fortress|family's fortress]] on the [[planet]]''[[Nexus of Power]]'' [[Devaron]]. Isa's son convinced his mother to hire the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch's]] clones—who were operating as [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]—to capture the [[Unidentified Pyke (Ord Mantell)|Pyke operative]] that had wronged their family by cutting off one of Roland's horns in exchange for information about the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]]'s [[Tantiss Base|laboratory]]. While in their Devaron [[fortress]] during or after [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|302}} Isa presided over the trial of a [[Unidentified Devaronian captain|Devaronian captain]] as part of the family's Durand's Council. From her [[throne]], she pronounced the defiant [[captain]] guilty of conspiracy and inquired whether he had any last words. When the captain accused her of making the Durand syndicate weaker under her leadership, she asked others present whether they agreed, garnering only silence in the audience chamber in response. Lady Durand then pressed a button on her throne that deactivated the [[force field]] beneath the captain's [[Limb|feet]], sending him falling into a dark pit. When she then indicated for her next audience to be brought before her, Roland obliged and signaled for the fortress's guards to open the doors. [[File:Durands-HunterWrecker-TBBPathsUnknown.png|thumb|right|300px|Isa and Roland Durand met with Hunter and Wrecker after they brought the Durands a Pyke who had wronged their family.]] The Bad Batch members [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] entered the chamber and presented the [[Pyke]] who had cut off Roland's horn to Isa. They tossed the severed horn piece to Roland, assuring Isa that the Pyke's capture would not be traced back to the Durands. After having the protesting Pyke taken away, the lady contemplated their reasoning for requesting information about Hemlock, musing that she would have [[Death|killed]] them if her son had not convinced her to consider their proposal. Eventually, she allowed Roland to provide the clones with coordinates to the doctor's [[laboratory]]. Although Hunter questioned the veracity of the information, Isa indicated that the pair should take what they came for and leave to not test her generosity. The two clones quickly left and later found the coordinates led to a different [[Imperial medical laboratory|laboratory]], which had been destroyed by [[orbital bombardment]], and wondered whether the Durand family's information had been accurate. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|You take what you want. That's the Durand way. It's a tactic my mother has perfected.|Roland Durand, to Omega|audio=RolandDurandWay-Infested.flac|}} Isa had [[Color|white]] [[hair]], red [[eye]]s, pale skin, and a pair of pale horns. She stood 2.01 [[meter]]s tall. The woman often maintained a moderated speaking tone when dealing with conflict, willing to execute harsh punishments on those threatening her family. Her son, Roland—who was often by her side{{Databank|isa-durand|Isa Durand}}—was at times able to convince his mother to consider various courses of action at his request. Isa was displeased with those who tested her patience, glaring at Hunter during his visit to the family's fortress. As a crime boss, the woman sought to teach her son that Durands always took what they wanted. ==Equipment== On Devaron, she wore a high-necked purple [[Clothing|dress]] accompanied by matching purple horn and hair accessories. Her dress additionally featured gold-colored chest ornamentation featuring the Durand syndicate's emblem,{{SW|url=infested-trivia-gallery|text=Tech's Notes: "Infested" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}} and she donned dark-colored shoes. The crime boss wielded a long [[staff]], which she used to call others to attention in her fortress audience chamber. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Anjelica_Huston.png|thumb|right|200px|In ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'', Isa Durand was voiced by Anjelica Huston.]] Isa Durand was first mentioned in "[[Infested]]," the thirteenth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released on [[July 23]], [[2021]].{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/infested-episode-guide|text="Infested" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} She first appeared in "[[Paths Unknown]]," the second episode of the series' [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[February 21]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} In the episode, Isa was voiced by [[Anjelica Huston]], an actor who had previously voiced the character of [[Sith Mother]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Visions]]'' anthology television series.{{Visions|Screecher's Reach (short film)}} The [[2014]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'', written by [[Adam Bray]], specifies that male Devaronians have horns while females are hornless.''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' However, in "Paths Unknown," Isa Durand is depicted with a pair of horns, and other female Devaronians have been depicted with horns in other media, such as the [[2015]] [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]''.''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]'' This article assumes that the precedent in ''Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide'' has since been [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]]. ==Appearances==
